baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possession construction dhu al-arsh joins an elevated royal locus to al-majid, whose nominative form describes the possessor rather than merely decorating the throne.
baseline_models.mechanism: Royal elevation supplies a center of rule, while noble glory and generosity qualify the one who possesses it; sovereignty is therefore presented as an honorable capacity, not as furniture or borrowed prestige.

activation_trace.role: The raised royal seat gives the possession construction a concrete center of elevated sovereignty.
Noble generosity, honor, and high rank make the possessor's elevation morally praiseworthy rather than merely dominant.

changed_reading.before: A glorious possessor has a throne.
changed_reading.after: The possessor occupies the highest center of rule, and the grammar marks that sovereign capacity itself as noble and generously glorious.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-arsh can name the standing support of authority that remains firm or is brought down, while al-majid can name multiplied favor.
baseline_models.mechanism: The throne is read functionally as the load-bearing order that keeps dominion from collapsing; its glory appears in the abundance it can sustain and distribute.

activation_trace.role: The standing support of rule turns the throne from an object into the structure by which authority holds together.
Multiplication of gift and favor makes sustained abundance the output of that stable order.

changed_reading.after: The throne signifies an uncollapsed governing order whose glory is demonstrated by the favor it can keep giving.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roof-and-shade branch of al-arsh and the sufficiency-and-fullness branch of al-majid coexist inside the two rooted words of the focus.
baseline_models.mechanism: A raised covering orders and protects the space beneath it; fullness supplies what that protected domain needs. Possession of the throne can thus imply capacious shelter rather than distance alone.

activation_trace.role: The raised roof or shade contributes an overhead structure that shelters a domain.
Full pasture and bodily sufficiency give the sheltered domain a material image of being amply supplied.

changed_reading.before: The throne places its possessor above creation.
changed_reading.after: The raised order also covers what is below, with glory felt as the sufficiency available under that shelter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-arsh includes the trellis that lifts vines on a support, and al-majid includes fullness and increased giving.
baseline_models.mechanism: A support does not produce the vine but makes its upward, fruitful growth possible. The possessed throne can therefore be imagined as an enabling architecture whose greatness is visible in flourishing rather than static height.

activation_trace.role: The vine trellis supplies a load-bearing form that raises and organizes living growth.
Increased gift supplies the fruitful yield by which the enabling support becomes glorious.

changed_reading.before: The throne is a finished emblem of power.
changed_reading.after: The throne is also an enabling support: its possessor raises, orders, and makes abundant growth possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sky that rises and shades, articulated by celestial or fortified towers, enlarges the focus throne from one elevated seat into a structured overhead domain. The shelter baseline becomes cosmic architecture with visible stations and defenses.

activation_trace.role: The focus's raised shade supplies the architectural form that the sky cue can enlarge.
What rises and overshadows supplies the cosmic scale and overhead orientation of the canopy.
Fortified towers segment the overhead expanse into a guarded and ordered domain rather than empty height.

structural_cues: The first oath places a towered overhead expanse before the focus's possessed raised structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies an overshadowing sky, fortified towers, and a raised shelter; the reader links them as nested architecture. A live alternative is that the opening oath supplies scale only, without making the throne itself canopy-like.

changed_reading.before: The throne is an elevated shelter or royal seat.
changed_reading.after: The throne becomes the organizing canopy of a towered cosmic domain, combining shelter, visibility, and defense.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded time, an appointment fixed to time or place, and reciprocal presence of witness and witnessed turn the royal-seat baseline into a court mechanism: sovereignty schedules appearance and makes testimony present.

activation_trace.role: The royal seat anchors the proposed judicial center in the focus rather than in the context alone.
A delimited span gives the sovereign encounter a temporal frame.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the act of convening the encounter.
Presence together with seeing supplies the evidentiary relation between witness and witnessed.

structural_cues: The promised day is immediately followed by the paired indefinite forms 'witness' and 'witnessed'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies bounded time, appointment, and witnessed presence; the reader assigns the throne the causal role of convening a court. A live alternative is a promised spectacle whose witnessing is not specifically judicial.

changed_reading.before: The throne marks possession of supreme rank.
changed_reading.after: The throne is an active seat of jurisdiction that fixes the encounter and brings witness and witnessed into accountable presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The persecutors occupy a fixed watching position above a long sunken cut whose fire consumes supplied fuel. This resembles a degraded human counter-throne: elevated spectatorship maintained by consumption. Against it, the focus throne is stable order whose majesty multiplies gift rather than fuel for destruction.

activation_trace.role: Stable support of authority supplies the focus-side governing structure against which the seated scene can be compared.
Multiplication of gift supplies the non-extractive measure of glory that reverses the persecutors' consumption.
The long sunken cut supplies the negative spatial center below the seated watchers.
Material fed to fire makes the human arrangement depend on continued consumption.
Sitting in ambush or observation supplies the fixed posture of coercive spectatorship.
Present seeing turns the seated posture into knowing participation rather than accidental proximity.

structural_cues: The scene descends from trench to fire and fuel, then rises to seated observers who witness what they do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies a trench, consumed fuel, seated surveillance, and witnessed action; the reader treats their arrangement as a parodic throne and contrasts its output with generous majesty. A live alternative is that the scene indicts cruelty without intentionally mirroring sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The glorious throne is a positive emblem of stable authority.
changed_reading.after: It also exposes a counterfeit authority: human power sits above a consuming pit, while glorious sovereignty supports and gives rather than feeding on those below.

context_deltas.mechanism: The persecutors' objection is set against invincible strength, abundant praiseworthiness, actual possession, and comprehensive witnessing. Those cues separate the focus majesty from competitive boasting: its legitimacy consists in effective ownership joined to morally praiseworthy knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The royal seat supplies the focus claim of sovereignty that the context tests for legitimacy.
Competitive vaunting supplies the nearby but rejected model of glory as prestige won over rivals.
Fault-finding locates contested judgment in the persecutors and raises the question of whose evaluation is valid.
Prevailing strength establishes that the focus sovereignty is not dependent on winning human acclaim.
Many praiseworthy qualities make moral worth, rather than self-display, the content of glory.
Possession with power of disposal supplies effective ownership behind the royal image.
Knowledge made evident supplies accountable perception rather than remote prestige.

structural_cues: The attributes of strength and praise lead directly into ownership of the upper and lower domains and witness over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies disputed blame, prevailing power, praise, ownership, and informed witness; the reader uses them as criteria that displace boastful glory. A live alternative is that the attributes accumulate honor without setting up an explicit theory of legitimacy.

changed_reading.before: Al-majid could denote glory displayed by prevailing in a contest of honor.
changed_reading.after: The throne's majesty is noncompetitive legitimacy: actual command, praiseworthy character, and knowledge of what occurs under that command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The furnace tests and blackens, whereas the concealed garden sustains continuous flow through opened channels. This contrast activates the trellis baseline: glorious order does not merely survive destructive testing; it supports a living system whose provision keeps moving.

activation_trace.role: The trellis supplies the focus-side structure that lifts and organizes fruitful growth.
Fullness and sufficiency make flourishing, rather than mere survival, the measure of the support.
Testing metal or a person supplies the destructive pressure against which productive order is disclosed.
A garden enclosed by its trees supplies the living domain organized beneath the support.
Continuing provision converts flow from scenery into the sustaining output of the system.
Opening and widening until something flows supplies the channel-making operation of the productive order.

structural_cues: Punitive fire is followed by a garden whose rivers run beneath it, reversing heat and consumption into concealed growth and flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies testing heat, a tree-covered garden, opened flow, and continuing provision; the reader makes the focus throne their enabling support. A live alternative is a simple punishment-reward contrast with no trellis-like function assigned to the throne.

changed_reading.before: The throne's stability keeps authority intact.
changed_reading.after: Its stability is productive: it opens channels and supports flourishing that continues after the furnace has exhausted its fuel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forceful seizure is held inside a longer sequence of nurture-to-completion, origination, return, protective covering, and love. The throne's stable order is therefore not only the capacity to stop evil; it can dismantle, reconstitute, protect, and restore relation.

activation_trace.role: The sustaining order of authority anchors the several operations as functions of one focus sovereignty.
Multiplying favor prevents severe power from becoming the final definition of majesty.
Forceful taking supplies the order's capacity to interrupt and seize.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply a constructive aim for lordly power.
Beginning paired with return supplies the first half of a repeatable restorative cycle.
Return after departure supplies reconstitution rather than irreversible destruction.
Covering a fault and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies protective reintegration.
Love supplies restored relation as the cycle's live positive end.

structural_cues: The severe grasp is followed without a new subject by beginning, returning, forgiving, and loving before the throne clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies seizure, nurture, beginning-return, protective forgiveness, and love; the reader orders them as one restorative arc governed from the throne. A live alternative is a list of independent capacities whose sequence does not imply a single cycle.

changed_reading.before: Stable sovereignty chiefly guarantees that destructive power cannot prevail.
changed_reading.after: Glorious sovereignty runs a severe but restorative cycle: it can seize, remake, shield from consequences, and renew attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Doing and willing immediately convert the throne from a credential into executable sovereignty. The support of rule remains glorious because intention passes into action without the throne becoming ceremonial or inert.

activation_trace.role: The standing support of authority supplies the institutional capacity through which will can take effect.
Bringing an act about supplies realized agency rather than nominal status.
Will and intention supply the initiating direction that realized action executes.

structural_cues: The focus's two nominal attributes are followed by an intensive agent form governing whatever is willed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies a stable authority-support, effective doing, and will; the reader draws a direct arrow from intention through throne-capacity to action. A live alternative is that the next clause asserts unrestricted agency without explaining the throne's function.

changed_reading.before: The throne certifies possession of authority.
changed_reading.after: The throne is the effective capacity by which sovereign intention continuously becomes action.

context_deltas.mechanism: What arrives as renewed report contains armies as mutually supporting collectives. Read beside majesty through commemorative mention, organized force is subordinated narratively: armies that seek durable power become report within the glorious possessor's larger order.

activation_trace.role: Magnifying through mention anchors the focus's glory in the act of retelling rather than military display.
Arrival makes the report an event that reaches the hearer in the present.
Speech renewed as news supplies the medium that contains and re-presents past force.
A mutually supporting host supplies the rival model of organized power that is reduced to narrated content.

structural_cues: After effective willing, an interrogative makes the report of collective force arrive as something already speakable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies arriving report, renewed speech, collective force, and glory intensified by mention; the reader infers that narration itself subordinates the armies. A live alternative is that the report merely offers an example of power with no contrast between force and memory.

changed_reading.before: Majesty is the possessor's enduring reputation.
changed_reading.after: Majesty also governs memory: organized powers become finite reports whose retelling magnifies the order that outlasts them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering truth, asserting its contrary, and placing something behind appearance are answered by complete surrounding knowledge. The throne's overhead shelter becomes spatially ambivalent: the same sovereign order that can cover protectively can close around attempts to hide.

activation_trace.role: The raised covering anchors the focus-side image whose protective orientation is revised into total enclosure.
Blocking the truth supplies the attempted epistemic cover inside the enclosing order.
Contradiction of truth supplies the false surface maintained by that cover.
Putting something behind visibility supplies the imagined refuge in hiddenness.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and custody closes the spatial and epistemic route of escape.

structural_cues: Denial is followed by a behind-them relation and an encompassing predicate, shifting the geometry from frontal opposition to all-around containment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies attempted covering, false assertion, hidden-behind placement, and complete enclosure; the reader makes sovereign shelter reverse according to relation, protective for what it holds and inescapable for what hides. A live alternative is that enclosure denotes knowledge or power without reactivating the throne's roof image.

changed_reading.before: The throne is the sheltering order above a domain.
changed_reading.after: The sovereign order is not only above but around: concealment attempted beneath it becomes containment within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated epithet moves from the throne-possessor to a gathered recitation, then into a broad written support under guard and retention. Majesty becomes transmissible: sovereign glory is made audible, collected, inscribed, and preserved without being reduced to a spatial seat.

activation_trace.role: The sustaining structure of rule anchors the source order from which textual manifestation is inferred.
Magnifying the possessor by recounting glory makes expression a possible carrier of majesty.
Gathering and collection supply the operation by which dispersed expression becomes a coherent recitation.
The same noble glory now directly qualifies the recited object, supplying the lexical transfer that activates the model.
A broad board used for writing or building supplies a material support for durable expression.
Retention within consciousness supplies preservation across reception as well as physical custody.

structural_cues: The exact epithet recurs after the focus, now agreeing with Quran, and the final prepositional phrase places that recitation in a preserved writing support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies repeated majid, gathering-recitation, a writable support, and retention; the reader draws an arrow from sovereign majesty to preserved textual manifestation. A live alternative is parallel praise of possessor and Quran with no claim that glory propagates between them.

changed_reading.before: The possessor's glory is localized in transcendent sovereignty.
changed_reading.after: That glory also enters history as gathered, recitable, writable, and retained expression: the throne's order becomes communicable without ceasing to transcend.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the specialized well-casing branch of al-arsh rather than the ordinary throne image. It remains anchored in the focus root and is materially sharpened by running rivers and continuing provision; downstream prose should present it as a hydraulic analogy for distributive sovereignty, not as a lexical replacement for 'throne'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus al-arsh can name the wooden structure and water-drawer's platform at a well mouth, while al-majid can name multiplied gift.

activation_trace.role: The well casing and drawing platform supply an elevated interface through which hidden water becomes distributable.
Multiplication of favor gives the hydraulic structure a distributive rather than merely mechanical function.
Continuing provision turns drawn water into an image of unceasing supply.
A river cutting the earth with flowing water extends the wellhead image into distributed channels below.

changed_reading.before: The throne concentrates authority at the highest point.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a wellhead of authority: a raised structure from which concealed provision is drawn and sent flowing through the domain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses al-majid's proverbial image of making much fire, a branch distant from the adjective's direct praise. The focus word and the context's explicit fire and fuel keep it anchored, while the contrast with multiplied giving makes the activation diagnostic; downstream prose should call it a moral reversal of fire-abundance, not an etymological definition of majid.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus al-majid carries both increasing fire in a proverb and multiplying gift, allowing abundance to be tested by what the fire is for.

activation_trace.role: The proverbial increase of fire supplies the unexpected lexical bridge to the context's deliberately fueled blaze.
Multiplication of gift supplies the generous purpose against which destructive fire-abundance is judged.
A blazing fire supplies the shared material whose moral direction can be reversed.
Supplied fuel makes abundance intentional and exposes whether provision serves welcome or consumption.

changed_reading.before: Majid simply intensifies the possessor's glory.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, majesty reverses the persecutors' economy of abundance: they heap provision into a fire that consumes, while true glory makes abundance serve giving.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch names specific star groups called arsh and could be over-literalized. It remains valid as an imaginal activation because the packet opens with the sky and its celestial towers; downstream prose should retain it as a resonance between named star-pattern and sovereign order, never identify the divine throne with a constellation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A branch of the focus al-arsh names an asterism, so the sky's patterned heights can reactivate the throne as a legible arrangement of elevated points.

activation_trace.role: The asterism named arsh supplies a direct but specialized focus-root image of patterned celestial elevation.
The sky as what rises and shades supplies the field in which the patterned points appear.
Celestial towers supply articulated stations that make the overhead field readable as order.

changed_reading.before: The throne is a singular seat above the cosmos.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, the throne also resonates with a patterned stellar order whose visible stations render sovereignty legible across the sky.

strongest_changes: The trench sequence produced a counter-throne reading: coercive spectatorship above consuming fire is reversed by a stable order that multiplies gift.
Severe grasp, beginning-return, forgiveness, and love turned static sovereignty into a restorative cycle able to interrupt and reconstitute.
The repeated majid moved glory from the sovereign possessor into gathered recitation, writing support, and preservation.
Denial and enclosure changed the throne's geometry from merely above to comprehensively around.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is only a possession phrase and two rooted words, yet its branch range generated coexisting royal, architectural, ecological, hydraulic, temporal, judicial, and textual mechanisms. The most productive constraint was the nominative majid: even when throne branches became strange, glory continued to qualify the possessor and therefore tested what each structure does.
remaining_uncertainties: The counter-throne and restorative-cycle readings depend on sequence-level causal arrows that the packet permits but does not state syntactically.
The later Quranun majid may be parallel praise rather than an intentional transfer of sovereign glory into text.
The wellhead, fire-proverb, and asterism activations should remain analogical and exploratory; none warrants replacing the ordinary throne sense.
